title_en: X-Men: The Animated Series and X-Men: Evolution Are Finally Crossing Over, as Marvel Reveals New Incursions Comics
summary_en: If you've ever dreamed of seeing the casts of X-Men: The Animated Series and X-Men: Evolution meet and do battle, then Marvel has just the book for you.
body_en:
Avengers: Doomsday is a movie that deals heavily with the concept of Incursions, the phenomenon where parallel versions of Earth begin to collide and threaten to destroy both universes. In the face of such an existential threat to the Marvel multiverse, even Robert Downey, Jr.'s Doctor Doom may be less a villain than the hero the MCU needs . Accordingly, Marvel Comics will dig deeper into the Incursion concept with a new series of companion comics that showcase various alternate universes colliding and battling for survival. That includes the worlds of X-Men: The Animated Series and X-Men: Evolution.
With Marvel releasing its full list of solicitations for December 2026, we now have a full idea of the plot and creative teams for the various Incursions one-shots. Scroll down to see what to expect from each one.
Written by Alex Paknadel
Art by Jim Towe
Witness what happens when the universe of the mutant-ascendent House of M intersects with that of the Days of Future Past! In eight hours, only one can survive, or both will collide and be utterly annihilated! This devastating choice is left in the hands of Kate Pryde!
Release Date: November 18, 2026
Written by Christos Gage
Art by Ron Lim
Spider-Gwen vs. Spider-Girl! Gwen Stacy the Ghost-Spider meets Mayday Parker, A.K.A. Spider-Girl, when Earth-65 and Earth-982 collide! The web of the Spider-Verse will never be the same!
Release Date: December 9, 2026
Written by Ethan S. Parker & Griffin Sheridan
Art by Paco Medina
A gamma-powered Fantastic Four? A cosmic-powered Bruce Banner? Can two Earths survive their heroes let alone an incursion?! When the skies turn red and a second Earth appears overhead, brilliant scientist Bruce Banner discovers an impossible truth: In just eight hours, two universes will collide, and both will be destroyed. As a gamma-powered Fantastic Four battles a rampaging cosmic-powered entity born from Banner’s desperate mission, Reed Richards faces the one problem even he can’t solve. In the final hours before oblivion, will Marvel’s First Family save their world...or find the courage to say goodbye?
Release Date: December 23, 2026
Written by Craig Kyle & Christopher Yost
Art by Salva Espin
X-Men ‘92 Vs. X-Men: Evolution! The X-Men of the 90’s must save their world! But can they do so when it means destroying another world in the process? Especially one filled with younger versions of themselves who still have hope for Xavier’s dream?
Release Date: January 6, 2027
Written by Al Ewing
Art by Fran Mariscal Mancilla
Marvel’s best vs. Marvel’s worst! Two Earths face off against each other for survival! One is an Earth where the early days of the Marvel Universe never ended, where the Avengers are still the founding lineup, where Spider-Man is still a high schooler. The other is an Earth ruled by Thanos and the monstrous villains of the Cabal. It’s the ultimate heroes vs. the ultimate villains! Can these Avengers defeat a group of foes at the heart of Secret Wars, or were they always doomed from the start?
Release Date: January 20, 2026
You can preorder all of these books at your local comic shop .
For more, find out about the Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man prequel comic and learn which major comics icon finally joined the Marvel Universe in Avengers: Armageddon #4.
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
